references.text: Jacob offered to serve Laban for seven years for Rachel because he loved her – the direct background for his service.
Jacob served an additional seven years for Rachel, demonstrating the depth of his love and commitment.
Isaac loved Rebekah – a parallel example of marital love among the patriarchs.
Jacob asked Laban to let him go with his wives and children after serving him, confirming his faithfulness and love for Rachel.
Love is as strong as death, and many waters cannot quench it – a deep parallel to Jacob's enduring love for Rachel.
The verses illuminate each other by contrasting the subjective experience of time in love with the objective reality that completion requires further trials.
